title: Principal/query args
description: Arguments for Principal/query (RFC 9670 §3.4). Returns an ordered list of Principal ids matching a filter.

accountId.description: The account to query principals from.

filter.description: Filter conditions. Supported properties: type (String), name (String), email (String), timeZone (String), description (String), hidden (Boolean).

sort.description: Sort criteria. Each Comparator has a property (e.g. name, type) and optional isAscending (default true).

position.description: 0-based index of the first result to return.

anchor.description: A PrincipalId to anchor the result page at.

anchorOffset.description: Offset from the anchor (may be negative).

limit.description: Maximum number of ids to return.

calculateTotal.description: If true, return the total number of matching principals.
